Labor Day isn’t just one day, it’s every day. I wouldn’t be here without unions. Unions made the Zenith underground iron ore mine on the Range where my grandpa worked safe. Unions gave my mom good wages as a teacher. Unions gave my dad his career with benefits through the newspaper guild. 

That's what unions do - they make life better for working families.

Gas prices are at a record high for Labor Day weekend, and diesel prices just hit an all-time high because of Donald Trump’s war with Iran.

Trump promised to lower costs on Day One – but his war has hit Minnesotans hard at the pump. My opponent won’t say it, but it’s time to end this reckless war.

posts.text: Congress needs to pass strong kids’ safety rules and make these platforms responsible for the products they build so they stop blaming parents. It’s not the parents. It’s the products.
posts.summary: Demands Congress regulate social media platforms to protect children
posts.quote: Congress needs to pass strong kids’ safety rules and make these platforms responsible for the products they build so they stop blaming parents. It’s not the parents. It’s the products.

posts.text: Parents shouldn’t have to fight Big Tech alone. We need rules of the road to hold tech companies accountable and protect kids.
posts.summary: Calls for tech accountability rules to protect children online
posts.quote: Parents shouldn’t have to fight Big Tech alone. We need rules of the road to hold tech companies accountable and protect kids.

posts.text: I’ve been taking on social media companies for years — from passing the bipartisan TAKE IT DOWN Act to stop the spread of sexually explicit deepfakes on social media to fighting to open the courtroom doors to parents harmed by Meta’s constant push to make money no matter the harm.
posts.summary: Highlights record of challenging social media companies on harms
posts.quote: I’ve been taking on social media companies for years — from passing the bipartisan TAKE IT DOWN Act to stop the spread of sexually explicit deepfakes on social media to fighting to open the courtroom doors to parents harmed by Meta’s constant push to make money no matter the harm.

posts.text: Meta has finally agreed to put in place critical reforms to its platform like time limits on social media and restrictions on push notifications, and it will pay $17 billion for the harm it caused.
posts.summary: Praises Meta settlement requiring platform safety reforms
posts.quote: Meta has finally agreed to put in place critical reforms to its platform like time limits on social media and restrictions on push notifications, and it will pay $17 billion for the harm it caused.

posts.text: Today’s landmark settlement between Meta and a coalition of states, including Minnesota, is a critical step toward protecting children online.
posts.summary: Celebrates Meta settlement as critical step for child protection
posts.quote: Today’s landmark settlement between Meta and a coalition of states, including Minnesota, is a critical step toward protecting children online.

posts.text: Our members are simply asking for the two-year delay so all states will be on the same footing in working to reduce their error rates. That is ten percent of the total SNAP cuts.
posts.summary: Seeks SNAP delay equitably across states with varying error rates
posts.quote: Our members are simply asking for the two-year delay so all states will be on the same footing in working to reduce their error rates. That is ten percent of the total SNAP cuts.

posts.text: It still advantages high error rate states over states with mid-level error rates. A state with an error rate twice that of Minnesota will pay nothing in the second year, whereas states that have reduced their error rates will still be disadvantaged over high error rate states.
posts.summary: Argues SNAP cuts unfairly disadvantage states with low error rates
posts.quote: It still advantages high error rate states over states with mid-level error rates. A state with an error rate twice that of Minnesota will pay nothing in the second year, whereas states that have reduced their error rates will still be disadvantaged over high error rate states.

posts.text: I also appreciate that the Chairman has acknowledged the problem with the SNAP cost shift to states and counties. But amid tariff-related rising grocery prices in states across the country where SNAP has been critical, this is only a one-year fix.

posts.quote: I also appreciate that the Chairman has acknowledged the problem with the SNAP cost shift to states and counties. But amid tariff-related rising grocery prices in states across the country where SNAP has been critical, this is only a one-year fix.
